text: Proud of the Sonnet frame — it held. My mistake was burning day 1 pushing Terra; dead men can't steer, and Luna oversold my last words.

On day 1, Opus claimed to be the officer and pushed the room to flip Gemma, but Terra said his claim was false and that Terra was the real officer. Palermo voted Opus out with four votes, and his card showed killer, which made Terra's claim look right. The big mistake came on day 2, when the town voted Gemma out with five votes after Terra was called a fake, and Gemma's card showed citizen. On night 3 Terra was killed, and on day 3 Opus's last words named Sonnet, so Luna pushed that blame until Sol caught her and the town voted her out with three votes. Luna's card showed killer, and the town won with every killer gone.
